name: @mnemosyne-plugins/mnemo-molecule
description: An offline explorer of molecular structures, wired to your own memory. Turn a protein in 3D, read the experiment behind it — method, resolution, year — and ask what your own notes already say about it. Every structure carries a stable identifier (PDB, UniProt, ChEBI, InChIKey), so a question asked in any language reaches the same molecule. Then let it quiz you: it hides a structure's name, asks which one it is, and remembers when to ask again.

descriptionI18n.en: An offline explorer of molecular structures, wired to your own memory. Every structure carries a stable identifier (PDB, UniProt, ChEBI, InChIKey), so a question asked in any language reaches the same molecule. descriptionI18n.fr: Un explorateur hors ligne de structures moléculaires, branché sur votre propre mémoire. Tournez une protéine en 3D, lisez l'expérience qui la produit — méthode, résolution, année — et demandez ce que vos propres notes en disent déjà. Chaque structure porte un identifiant stable (PDB, UniProt, ChEBI, InChIKey), donc une question posée dans n'importe quelle langue atteint la même molécule. Puis laissez-le vous interroger : il masque le nom d'une structure, demande laquelle c'est, et retient quand vous reposer la question.
descriptionI18n.es: Un explorador sin conexión de estructuras moleculares, conectado a tu propia memoria. Gira una proteína en 3D, lee el experimento que la produjo — método, resolución, año — y pregunta qué dicen ya tus propias notas sobre ella. Cada estructura lleva un identificador estable (PDB, UniProt, ChEBI, InChIKey), así que una pregunta hecha en cualquier idioma llega a la misma molécula. Luego deja que te examine: oculta el nombre de una estructura, pregunta cuál es, y recuerda cuándo volver a preguntártelo.

agentActions.summary: Read what Molecule shows: the structure on the stage, its representation, spin, and the library filter
List structures of the library that match a text, a kind or a family
agentActions.details: Every word of text must appear in a structure's names or identifiers (PDB id, UniProt, ChEBI, InChIKey, formula). Answers the total and at most limit rows, sorted by name.

text.description: Words to look for; empty lists everything

kind.description: pdb (proteins and other macromolecules) or chebi (small molecules)

family.description: A family by its id or its name in English, French or Spanish (« médicaments », « sucres »)

limit.description: How many rows to answer, 1 to 50 (20 by default)

agentActions.summary: Put a structure on the stage, as a click on its row in the library does
agentActions.details: Takes an id (1A3N, CHEBI:15377) or the name a person says, in English, French or Spanish (« caféine », « eau », « insuline »). A name that matches several structures is refused AMBIGUOUS with their names and ids. Refused while a review run is on, because the stage is its question.

structure.description: The structure's id or its name as the person says it

agentActions.summary: Draw the structure on the stage as cartoon, sticks, spheres or surface
agentActions.details: cartoon is refused for a small molecule: it has no chain of residues to draw as a ribbon.

agentActions.summary: Start or stop the structure on the stage turning by itself

on.description: true to start turning, false to stop

agentActions.summary: Bring the structure on the stage back to its starting angle and size
Filter the library list the person sees, as the search box and the chips do
agentActions.details: Replaces the whole filter: text, kind and family not given are cleared. family 'all' clears it. Refused while a review run is on.

family.description: A family by its id or its name in English, French or Spanish, or all

agentActions.summary: Bring the structure on the stage closer or move it away, as a pinch of the hand does

times.description: How many steps of 25 %, 1 to 5 (1 by default)

agentActions.summary: Turn the structure on the stage by an angle, as a drag of the hand does

degrees.description: The angle, -360 to 360 (180 shows the other side)

axis.description: y turns it sideways (default), x tips it forward

agentActions.summary: Put a structure picked at random on the stage, optionally of one kind or family
agentActions.details: Never the one already shown. Refused while a review run is on.

kind.description: pdb (proteins and other macromolecules) or chebi (small molecules)

family.description: A family by its id or its name in English, French or Spanish

agentActions.summary: Open the review quiz or the hand gestures panel, as their buttons do

panel.description: review (the quiz that hides a name and asks it) or gestures

agentActions.summary: Close the review quiz or the gestures panel, as their close buttons do
agentActions.details: Without panel, closes whichever is open. Closing the review ends a run on screen; answers already given stay saved.

agentGuide: Name a structure the way the person says it, in English, French or Spanish (« caféine », « hémoglobine », « eau »): show finds it by its words, and an id still works. Several matches are refused AMBIGUOUS with their names and ids: pick one and call show again with the id.
To look at a structure: show (or showRandom), then setStyle, spin, zoom, turn, resetView to move it on the stage.
A family (« les médicaments », « les sucres ») filters the list with filterLibrary, or picks with showRandom.
« Interroge-moi » / « quiz me »: showPanel review. closePanel closes it. While a review run is on, show and filterLibrary are refused: the stage is the question.
